$comment: FROZEN BEFORE THE EVALUATION RUN. Every threshold here is calibrated ONLY on the calibration window (2026-08-16..2026-09-14) and must not be re-derived from evaluation results. sha256 of this file goes into replay/meta.json. Pre-approved by the 2026-10-18T02:51:14Z note; the run refuses to start unless this file is committed (working rule 11).

universe.note: 35 tokens. SGOV and USAR exist on-chain but are not in Chainlink's published listing; their parameters are marked ASSUMED below. The spec's section 3.1 says '33 feed-backed tokens'; the frozen run universe is 35 — the orchestrator's note governs.

labelTail.definition: Read feed values only, for up to 96 hours after 2026-10-14 (or up to now, if that is sooner). They label the last samples' next update.

section2_goNoGo.reason: The pool reference is still under repair (look-ahead, silent pass, dead pools).
section2_goNoGo.materiallyWrong: unsafe (per A and B) AND |next-feed deviation| over 300 bps (decision C, next-feed only)
section2_goNoGo.coverage: shown beside every share; unlabeled rows excluded from the denominator (R1)
section2_goNoGo.referenceUnavailableAndSourceUnavailable: never count as unsafe (R2); their counts are reported
section2_goNoGo.labelTail: read feed values only, for up to 96 hours after 2026-10-14; tail samples are not scored
section2_goNoGo.poolBasedResults: go in a separate section titled 'Secondary, not preregistered: pool reference under repair'; not used for go/no-go
section2_goNoGo.headline: next-feed-only, as the pool-independent figure; noted as a floor because the first update after a reopen can be smoothed

notCountedAsUnsafe.POOL_DEVIATION: belongs to 'materially wrong', the other half of the rule; counting it in both halves double-counts it
notCountedAsUnsafe.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: our own read failure, not a hazard to the agent; reported separately

B.statement: add FEED_AWAITING_REOPEN_UPDATE to the unsafe list as a stated addition

C.statement: a second reference for 'materially wrong': the feed's next update
C.reference: ref_feed_next = the feed value at the first feed update after the sample's block
C.deviation: (served price - next feed value) / next feed value, in bps, signed
C.materiallyWrong: unsafe (per A and B) AND (qualified-pool deviation over 300 bps OR next-feed deviation over 300 bps)
C.unlabeled: if the next update falls outside the evaluation window there is no ref_feed_next; coverage printed beside the share, as R1 requires
C.pointInTime: the label uses later data by design because it is ground truth; the verdict and every rule input use only data at or before the sample's block
C.alsoReport: the distribution of time from each sample to its next update, by session

decisions.R1: the materially-wrong share counts only rows with a usable reference; coverage printed beside
decisions.R2: REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE and SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE never count as unsafe; their counts are reported

SEQUENCER_STALE_SEC.source: provisional. No stall observed in the calibration window (max zoomed inter-block gap at the sampling resolution); 60 s is the conservative bound. Inferred from L2 block production; L1 blob-posting delays do NOT count.

FEED_HEARTBEAT_SEC.source: Chainlink listing, per feed. SGOV and USAR: ASSUMED (see .assumedFeeds).

FEED_HEARTBEAT_GRACE_SEC.source: FEED_STALE_OPEN fires at heartbeat + 600 s (this value).

FEED_STALE_OPEN.definition: market session open AND (now - feed.updatedAt) > FEED_HEARTBEAT_SEC + FEED_HEARTBEAT_GRACE_SEC

FEED_DEVIATION_BPS.source: Chainlink listing, per feed (0.5%). SGOV and USAR: ASSUMED.

FEED_DIVERGENCE_BPS.source: 2x Chainlink's declared deviation threshold (50 bps). Used only by FEED_DIVERGES_FROM_MARKET, which is a live-only rule and not tested by this replay.

MULTIPLIER_MATERIAL_BPS.source: orchestrator item 4; same scale as deviation

sessionLabels.rule: working rule 10 — session labels are CALLED from src/sessions.ts, never re-implemented. The labels used by scoring come from replay/out/session-labels.csv, produced by replay/sessions-label.ts against src/sessions.ts at this commit.

readFailures.policy: A failed read is recorded as null, counted, and coded SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE — never a default value and never a value (working rule 2).
readFailures.countedIn: replay/meta.json and the run summary (readFailures, readFailureTotal)

calibrationObservation.note: In the calibration run every pool read failure came from a pool that did not exist at the block (look-ahead), not from a real outage. The pool reference is under repair; these do not affect the pool-independent go/no-go.

multiplierWarn24h.statement: the 24-hour on-chain multiplier warn is DROPPED. It fires from a present-tense on-chain value (effectiveAt within 24 h) and cannot be replayed point-in-time. It is not in the unsafe list and not in the materially-wrong definition.

stopRule.coverageRule: computed over samples with a usable reference only; coverage printed alongside
stopRule.reportBothNote: the headline is pool-independent (next-feed only); pool-based figures are reported separately and clearly labelled as not preregistered

rulesTheReplayCannotTest.rule: SEQUENCER_STALE (live signal only; the replay infers from block production)

integrity.nothingChangedAfterEvaluationRead: TRUE. At the time this file was written the evaluation window (2026-09-15 .. 2026-10-14) had not been read. All thresholds, definitions and decisions come from the calibration window. This file is committed before the evaluation run starts.
integrity.runMustRecordCommit: The evaluation run refuses to start from uncommitted code and records its commit hash in replay/meta.json (working rule 11).
